targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__unixEpochGroupAlias(rc.cycle_timestamp, $__interval),
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'periodic' AND ir.success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS periodic_rotated,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'periodic' AND (ir.success = false OR ir.success IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS periodic_not_rotated,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'inactive_proxy' AND ir.success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS continuous_rotated,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'inactive_proxy' AND (ir.success = false OR ir.success IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS continuous_not_rotated
FROM rotation_cycles rc
JOIN ip_rotations ir ON ir.cycle_id = rc.id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
  AND rc.cycle_timestamp >= DATE_SUB($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
  AND rc.cycle_type IN ('periodic', 'inactive_proxy')
  AND p.active = true
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  $__unixEpochGroupAlias(rc.cycle_timestamp, $__interval),
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'periodic' AND ir.success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'periodic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    4
  ) AS periodic_success_rate,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'inactive_proxy' AND ir.success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'inactive_proxy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    4
  ) AS continuous_success_rate
FROM rotation_cycles rc
JOIN ip_rotations ir ON ir.cycle_id = rc.id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
  AND rc.cycle_timestamp >= DATE_SUB($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
  AND rc.cycle_type IN ('periodic', 'inactive_proxy')
  AND p.active = true
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  t.proxy_id,
  t.device_name,
  SUM(t.periodic_rotated) AS periodic_rotated,
  SUM(t.periodic_not_rotated) AS periodic_not_rotated,
  SUM(t.continuous_rotated) AS continuous_rotated,
  SUM(t.continuous_not_rotated) AS continuous_not_rotated,
  SUM(t.periodic_rotated + t.continuous_rotated) AS total_rotated,
  SUM(t.periodic_not_rotated + t.continuous_not_rotated) AS total_not_rotated
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.proxy_id,
    COALESCE(s.device_name, p.name, s.proxy_id) AS device_name,
    SUM(s.ip_rotation_periodic_success_count) AS periodic_rotated,
    SUM(s.ip_rotation_periodic_failure_count) AS periodic_not_rotated,
    SUM(s.ip_rotation_inactive_proxy_success_count) AS continuous_rotated,
    SUM(s.ip_rotation_inactive_proxy_failure_count) AS continuous_not_rotated
  FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
  JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = s.proxy_id
  WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom())
    AND s.day < CURDATE()
    AND p.active = true
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY s.proxy_id, COALESCE(s.device_name, p.name, s.proxy_id)

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ir.proxy_id,
    COALESCE(p.name, ir.proxy_id) AS device_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'periodic' AND ir.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS periodic_rotated,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'periodic' AND (ir.success = 0 OR ir.success IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS periodic_not_rotated,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'inactive_proxy' AND ir.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS continuous_rotated,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'inactive_proxy' AND (ir.success = 0 OR ir.success IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS continuous_not_rotated
  FROM ip_rotations ir
  JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
  JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id
  WHERE ir.rotation_timestamp >= GREATEST($__timeFrom(), CURDATE())
    AND ir.rotation_timestamp <= $__timeTo()
    AND rc.cycle_type IN ('periodic', 'inactive_proxy')
    AND p.active = true
    AND p.location IN ($location)
  GROUP BY ir.proxy_id, COALESCE(p.name, ir.proxy_id)
) t
GROUP BY t.proxy_id, t.device_name
HAVING total_rotated > 0 OR total_not_rotated > 0
ORDER BY total_not_rotated DESC, total_rotated DESC
LIMIT 200;
